rules.reason: Force pushes to main/master can overwrite team changes
rules.suggestion: Use --force-with-lease instead or create a backup branch first

rules.reason: Recursive deletion from root can destroy the entire system
rules.suggestion: Use more specific paths or rm -rf with confirmation

rules.reason: Destructive database commands without WHERE clause can cause data loss
rules.suggestion: Add WHERE clause or use SELECT first to verify

rules.reason: Sudo commands run with elevated privileges and can cause system damage
rules.suggestion: Ensure you understand the command and have proper authorization

rules.reason: git clean permanently removes untracked files
rules.suggestion: Use -n flag first to preview what would be deleted
